### proc.fieldSprite

Trace a signed field with editable materials and expose native-grid position, normal, depth, light and coverage.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `field` | Required | {"layout":"Function or native object with a sample method"} |
| Input | `materials` | `array<fieldSpriteMaterial>` | `[]` | {"items":"fieldSpriteMaterial"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"width":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"integer":true,"min":1}},"height":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"integer":true,"min":1}},"time":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds"},"orbit":{"type":"vec2","unit":"radians","default":[0,0.18]},"steps":{"type":"number","constraints":{"min":8,"max":128,"integer":true},"default":64}} |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `materialId` | `raster` | — | slot index · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":-1,"max":16} |
| Output | `depth` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `normal` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `position` | `raster` | — | field-coordinate XYZ · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[3,3],"finite":true} |
| Output | `illumination` | `raster` | — | light ratio · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,1],"finite":true,"min":0,"max":1} |
| Output | `coverage` | `raster` | — | coverage ratio · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,1],"finite":true,"min":0,"max":1} |
| Output | `surface` | `fieldSpriteSurface` | — |  |

- Position and normals use the signed field coordinate space. Use coverage to identify hits.
- Up to 16 material slots paint in array order. Surface retains unpainted color and trace data for reuse.

Guides: [guide](../field-sprite-materials.md), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#procedural-pixel-effects)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe proc.fieldSprite --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### proc.plasma

Combine independently animated oscillators and map the result to indexed color.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `geometry` | `array<record>` | `[{"id":"cross","type":"plane","frequency":2.4,"angle":0.1,"weight":0.85},{"id":"rings","type":"radial","frequency":3.2,"center":[0.35,0.53]},{"id":"curl","type":"spiral","frequency":1.6,"arms":2,"center":[0.65,0.39],"weight":0.6}]` | {"items":"record"} |
| Input | `motion` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `palette` | `palette` | `["#181731","#292347","#44325d","#684066","#90516d","#b56774","#d3857c","#e8a787","#f2c98f","#f9e7b7"]` | {"minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"entries":"RGB integer, #rrggbb or normalized RGB triple"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"width":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"integer":true,"min":1}},"height":{"type":"number","unit":"pixels","constraints":{"integer":true,"min":1}},"time":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds"},"range":{"type":"vec2","description":"Increasing field interval mapped onto the palette slots.","default":[-1,1]}} |
| Output | `value` | `displayRaster` | — | display byte levels · {"channels":[1,4],"samples":[0,255]} |
| Output | `indices` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `palette` | `palette` | — | {"minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"entries":"RGB integer, #rrggbb or normalized RGB triple"} |
| Output | `field` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |

- Geometry lists 1–16 named plane, radial or spiral oscillators.
- Motion is keyed by oscillator ID. Phase is in turns, rate in turns per second, and velocity in shorter-side lengths per second.
- The scalar field is divided by the sum of absolute weights before indexing. Changing only the swatches preserves indices.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#procedural-generation-and-recipes), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#generate-indexed-plasma)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe proc.plasma --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
